summary: ι⁻¹(K) is the level of K_f given by the stabilisers (under inverse transpose) of the k₀-th basis vector modulo the f places above N; its index is (N^k − 1)^f.

steps.claim: Identify ι⁻¹(K) with levelOf(the product over the places w above N of the stabilisers of e_{k₀} in GL_k(𝔽_w), via inverse transpose) and compute its relative index as an index in the product.
steps.lean:
rw [(?_ : comap .. = levelOf (↑) (pi ⊤ fun w : D.piPlaces ↦
    (stabilizer _ (Pi.single D.shape.k₀ 1 : _ → ResField w.1)).comap invTransposeGL.toMonoidHom)),
    relIndex_levelOf (h := ⟨by simp, by simp [D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.star_notMem]⟩)]

steps.claim: Each factor has index N^k − 1 (stabiliser of a nonzero vector in GL_k(𝔽_N)), there are f places, and #X₀ = k.
steps.lean:
simp [index_pi_univ, index_comap, index_stabilizer_GL_vector, card_ResField,
    D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.q_eq, ↓card_X₀, card_piPlaces, Fin.pos']

steps.claim: The identification, elementwise: membership in K of ι(x);
is equivalent to the stabiliser condition at each place,
steps.lean:
refine exists_prop.symm.trans (exists_congr fun h ↦
    (?_ : _ ↔ ∀ w _, (transposeGL _)⁻¹ ∈ stabilizer ..))

steps.claim: because divisibility by the primes above N is reduction to 0 there.
